name: Little Shore
summary:
Little Shore is a cosy, relaxing god game inspired by Celtic folklore, Scottish landscapes, and a touch of Burtonesque whimsy.

Take on the role of a gentle deity and breathe life into a mysterious, forgotten world. Sculpt layered islands, shape coastlines and hills, build charming settlements, and watch your tiny Wee Folk develop lives of their own. Gather Belief from your growing population to unlock new buildings, natural decorations, and divine powers. Create beautiful surroundings to inspire Wonder, encourage your Wee Folk to worship at ancient Shrines, and gradually awaken new lands. No combat, no timers, and no pressure. Just your own wee corner of the world.
